title: TC-EXP-301-08 leaks 3 allocations on the duplicate-idempotency-key path in event_store store.append/rowToEventRecord
notes: Discovered incidentally while fixing GH-654/ISS-0649's TC-EXP-301-09 pool-exhaustion bug in src/effects/worker.zig -- unrelated to that fix, this test (TC-EXP-301-08, a sibling test in the same file) passes (32/32 tests pass) but the DebugAllocator reports 3 leaked allocations. Stack trace: tests/integration/effects_subsystem_test.zig:898 (`const second = try store.append(allocator, params)`) -> src/event_store/store.zig:472 (`break :orig_blk rowToEventRecord(allocator, live_rows.rows[0], "") catch ...`) -> src/event_store/store.zig:1180 (`const payload = try allocator.dupe(u8, if (row.len > 3) row[3] orelse "{}" else "{}")`). This is the same code path GH-521/ISS-0187 fixed the PoolError.ExhaustedPool symptom for (store.append's duplicate-idempotency-key lookup path, which acquires a second connection to fetch the original event's row) -- but that fix apparently did not free the EventRecord returned by rowToEventRecord() on the duplicate-replay branch, or a caller along that path drops it without calling its .deinit()/free helper.
root_cause: Confirmed hypothesis (a): TC-EXP-301-08 calls store.append(allocator, params) twice with the same idempotency key to exercise the duplicate-detection path. Both calls return an AppendResult whose .record field owns 3 allocations (event_type, payload, metadata -- see EventRecord.deinit() in src/event_store/store.zig:96-100). The test read .is_duplicate off both results but never called .record.deinit(allocator) on either one, so both AppendResults' owned EventRecords leaked. This is a test-fixture omission, not a bug in store.append() or rowToEventRecord() itself -- the established caller contract (already followed correctly by tests/integration/event_store_integration_test.zig:409,420) is that every store.append() result's .record must be freed by the caller via defer.
acceptance_criteria: TC-EXP-301-08 passes with 0 leaked allocations (DebugAllocator reports clean)
No change to the test's or store.append()'s observable behavior (duplicate detection, is_duplicate flag, event count) -- this is a pure memory-lifetime fix
next_action: File as GitHub issue and add to global queue. MINOR severity -- does not fail any test (leak detection is a separate DebugAllocator diagnostic, not part of the test assertion), and is unrelated to GH-654/ISS-0649's own scope.
resolution:
Added the missing `defer first.record.deinit(allocator);` and `defer second.record.deinit(allocator);` calls to TC-EXP-301-08 in tests/integration/effects_subsystem_test.zig, matching the established ownership pattern in tests/integration/event_store_integration_test.zig:409,420. Changed `const first`/`const second` to `var` since .deinit() requires a mutable receiver. No behavioral change -- .is_duplicate and event-count assertions are unchanged.

Verified: zig build test-integration-effects-subsystem -- 32/32 pass, 0 leaks (was 32/32 pass with 3 leaked allocations before this fix), re-run twice to confirm consistency. zig build exits 0 with no error-set output. tools/lint_sql_param_types.py src tests -- 0 BLOCKER/MAJOR/MINOR. Full zig build test regression: 89/89 steps succeeded, 1011/1075 tests passed (64 skipped) -- identical to the pre-fix session baseline, confirming no unrelated breakage.
